scientific_summary: For three pairwise-independent observations with a common atomless margin, the full six-pattern labelled ordering law is exactly a two-dimensional triangle with reversal symmetry; this gives sharp rank and two-calibration-score conformal p-value envelopes.
limitations: The characterization is specific to three observations; sharp torus extremizers are singular as three-dimensional laws; the conformal consequence has only two calibration scores; older label-sensitive copula or order-pattern literature remains a residual originality risk.
